capability.summary: Run ShellCheck JSON diagnostics on one local shell script
capability.description: Executes exactly `shellcheck -f json <file>` and returns ShellCheck's parsed diagnostic array in a JSON execution envelope. Exit codes 0 and 1 are treated as completed scans; the script is not modified.
capability.problem_space: Read-only ShellCheck diagnostics for one shell script using fixed JSON output; not shell execution, formatting, automatic fixes, security proof, arbitrary ShellCheck option forwarding, or multi-file project orchestration.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing shell script. Executes `shellcheck -f json <file>` with inherited cwd. Output: JSON envelope with parsed ShellCheck diagnostics, exit code, and raw stream metadata.
accepted_inputs: an existing shell script file supported by the installed ShellCheck version
constraint.output_shape: ShellCheck exit 0 or 1: {status: "success", tool: "shellcheck", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: array|JSON value|null, stdout: string|null, stderr: string|null}; normal native JSON is placed in result with stdout=null. Other exits use status="tool_error" and propagate the exit code. Missing file, executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "shellcheck", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: does not execute the shell script, apply fixes, rewrite files, or guarantee runtime correctness or security
accepts one existing shell-script file; a directory or a multi-file project target is outside this wrapper's input boundary
passes only fixed `-f json`; no shell dialect, severity, enable/disable code, external-source, source-path, or exclusion options are exposed
uses a fixed 120-second timeout and no output truncation; when stderr rather than stdout parses as JSON, the helper still suppresses stdout

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing parsed ShellCheck diagnostics, exit code, and captured streams; the source file is unchanged.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: lint a shell script with ShellCheck
get JSON ShellCheck diagnostics for one file
negative_intents: execute or format a shell script
lint Python JavaScript CSS or compile code
